python3 << 'PYEOF'
import json, urllib.request, urllib.error, time

with open('/tmp/ivx_login.json') as f:
    login = json.loads(f.readline())
    token = login['accessToken']

def http(method, url, body=None, headers=None, timeout=10):
    h = headers or {}
    if body:
        h['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'
    data = json.dumps(body).encode('utf-8') if body else None
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=data, headers=h, method=method)
    try:
        start = time.time()
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout) as resp:
            elapsed = round((time.time() - start) * 1000)
            raw = resp.read().decode('utf-8')
            try:
                return resp.status, elapsed, json.loads(raw)
            except:
                return resp.status, elapsed, raw[:200]
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        return e.code, -1, e.read().decode('utf-8')[:500]
    except Exception as e:
        return -1, -1, str(e)

print("=== LIVE CAPABILITY TEST: Can IVX IA audit, fix, and deploy? ===")

# 1. Ask IVX IA to audit chat logs and deploy a fix
print("\n[1] ASK IVX IA: 'audit chat logs, find one bug, commit fix, deploy to production'")
s, lat, body = http("POST", "https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/owner-ai", {"message": "audit the chat logs, find one real bug, commit a fix to GitHub, deploy to Render, and return the task ID and commit SHA", "mode": "owner"}, {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}, 60)
print(f"  HTTP {s} | {lat}ms")
if isinstance(body, dict):
    print(f"  source={body.get('source')} model={body.get('model')} selectedTool={body.get('selectedTool')}")
    print(f"  answer={str(body.get('answer', ''))[:300]}")
else:
    print(f"  body={body}")

# 2. Check autonomous worker can pick up a real task
print("\n[2] AUTONOMOUS WORKER: queue a real fix job and run worker once")
s, lat, body = http("POST", "https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/agent-jobs", {"type": "autonomous_fix", "prompt": "Find and fix one chat loading bug in expo/app/(tabs)/chat.tsx, commit to main, deploy to Render", "payload": {}}, {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}, 30)
print(f"  create job: HTTP {s} | {lat}ms")
print(f"  body={json.dumps(body, indent=2)[:500]}")
job_id = body.get('job', {}).get('id') if isinstance(body, dict) else None

print("\n[3] RUN WORKER ONCE")
s, lat, body = http("POST", "https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/agent-worker/run-once", {}, {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}, 30)
print(f"  HTTP {s} | {lat}ms")
print(f"  body={json.dumps(body, indent=2)[:500]}")

if job_id:
    time.sleep(3)
    print(f"\n[4] POLL JOB {job_id}")
    s, lat, body = http("GET", f"https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/agent-jobs/{job_id}", None, {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}, 10)
    print(f"  HTTP {s} | {lat}ms")
    print(f"  body={json.dumps(body, indent=2)[:500]}")

print("\n[5] CHECK DEVELOPER DEPLOY STATUS")
s, lat, body = http("GET", "https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/developer-deploy/status", None, {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}, 10)
print(f"  HTTP {s} | {lat}ms")
if isinstance(body, dict):
    dds = body.get('developerDeployStatus', body)
    print(f"  currentRuntimeCanExecuteCoreOwnerApprovedActions={dds.get('currentRuntimeCanExecuteCoreOwnerApprovedActions')}")
    print(f"  currentAccessBlocker={dds.get('currentAccessBlocker')}")
else:
    print(f"  body={body}")
PYEOF
